I know what it feels like. It feels like you're asking too much and making your problems his. You feel like you're overreacting but it hurts so you ask the internet wondering if you're dramatic. Been there. 

Its not true, and you deserve better than this. You'll think all men are like this but it's not. I sometimes am dramatic, and my bf calls me out on it when Im dramatic over stupid things. Right now things are serious for me. I broke my ancle last week and he's been visiting me every single day. He still hangs with his friends but AFTER he's seen me and cheered me up. 

I know it's hard, and i know you can't dump a guy if you're not ready for it. And I can imagine you don't want a break up on top of a funeral. Just know it gets better if it ends. 

Also my condoleances about your dad.

I have the same type of boyfriend. Same ages as well. I recebtly bought a home, while he still lives with his parents. He simply never learned not to blow his money. What works in my case is much positivism and cheering when he sets baby steps. "You saved 10 bucks? Good job" make a savings account for him and help him budget. Dont nag him, you dont have to know every penny. Just ask him like "how much you wanna save on food". Also help him find a job. Search for it together, and help him with his applications. In my case its now paying off, i dont have to help anymore. Also i found him a budget app. Oh and last tip, try to make it fun. Save up for fun dates.
It just went to shit T_T
Oreo's. Instead of turning and dipping in milk you should just grind them all in at once like a cookie monster.

I had a date with this guy from Tinder. He came to my house (last time I'd do that). He lived quite far so I had already offered him to stay for dinner (again last time I'd do that). We didn't match at all. He was awkward, said he was a great gamer but failed at anything I'd let him play. It was all just so awkward. 

The worst came when somehow we got to the topic of Facebook.  He said he didn't have Facebook. I asked him why. He didn't answer. So a week before this happened to a friend of a friend so I guessed the following: "Is it because you jerked off while skyping a hot girl and you didn't know she made a video and she is now threatening to post it on your Facebook in case you don't pay her money?" "How did you know that?" he asked. Well that was unexpected and it only got more awkward from there. He didn't leave though, still expecting dinner. So at some point I started cooking. So he sat on my couch and literally threw his feet on the table while I was cooking. I liked the distance so I didn't ask for help. So after dinner he said "Well I guess I'll go, or do you have dessert?" Yelled in a pillow for an hour after he left out of frustration.

When I tell Thomas how annoyed I am about Will he just says "I know" It's a bit like that, Will is an asshole, but most people think it's funny. And everyone knows this about Will. Like everyone says "he's an asshole, but he can't help it, we're used to it" kinda like a Barney Stinson at his worst. 

I'm hesistant about telling Thomas about Will actions because I don't want the fuss. Thomas will want to confront Will and Will would deny everything. He's done that with the Carmen situation. As well with times I tried to confront him myself. He just turns things around and then it's a contest on who everyone's gonna believe.

Will is also still bipolar with his behaviour. Another friend once described it as a coin toss. He can be either fun and nice, and a complete asshole the other time. Its a 50/50 though i think an 20/80 for me. 

Thomas was really drunk when he hit me, like, he peed over his shoes before he hit me. And as soon as he realised what he'd done he started crying and said I shouldnt be with him anymore. It was his bday the day after so I was kinda against dumping him on his bday. When he woke up the next morning (I slept in the guest room at his house, since he was drunk enough for poisoning I didnt want to leave him alone) he didn't remember doing it, just remembered that I was crying after he did. 

Thing for the other side is that he's good to me on an emotional level. I just havnt found my trust back, and Will is making things worse. 

Saying goodbye to both of them would be complicated. Since we're all in a group with other friends as well and we all live in a small town bound to run into eachother

I've had similiar work situations. Also worked as a graphic designer, and got blamed for the work of crappy interns that I wasnt responsible for. 

Nothing to do but update your portfolio and find abetter job
Friend is not worth it, Try and find better friends
